newsitem.title: USA: Wal-Mart division oper profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Wal-Mart division oper profit rises.

text.p: Wal-Mart Stores Inc said Tuesday that its Wal-Mart division had a third quarter operating profit of $1.27 billion, a 10 percent increase from $1.15 billion for the same period last year.
The company said its Sam's division had an operating profit for the quarter of $207 million, up five percent from $197 million for the previous year period.
The company said its International Division had an operating loss of $15 million for the quarter, compared with an operating loss of $10 million for the same period last year.
Year to date, the company said international operating loss was $41 million as compared with an operating loss of $3 million last year.
First Call projected third quarter earnings per share at $0.31. The company reporting earnings of $0.30 per share.
